name: Automotive Technology
description: Automotive technology programmes train the people who diagnose and repair cars and light trucks — engines, transmissions, brakes, steering and suspension, electrical and electronic systems, heating and air conditioning, and the emissions and engine management that tie them together. ⚠ It is one of the most widely available programmes in Florida, and almost all of it is taught at technical colleges.
degreesNote: Florida teaches this as CLOCK-HOUR career certificates rather than degrees, and the structure is worth understanding before you enrol. The state framework Master Automotive Service Technology runs 1,800 hours across nine occupational completion points — each one a hireable exit: services assistor, engine repair, automatic transmission, manual drivetrain, suspension and steering, brakes, electrical and electronic systems, heating and air conditioning, and engine performance. ⚠ You can stop at a completion point, work, and come back for the next one; that is what the structure is for. A shorter Maintenance and Light Repair certificate (600 hours) is the fastest way into paid work, and several colleges add an associate degree in automotive service MANAGEMENT above the certificates for people moving toward running a shop. ⚠⚠ Florida Statute 1004.925 requires every automotive service technology education programme in the state to be INDUSTRY CERTIFIED — ask any programme to show you its ASE Education Foundation certification before you enrol.

cips.note: Automobile/automotive mechanics technology — the programme itself. 47 Florida public institutions award in it, 932 credentials in 2023, and the great majority of them are district technical colleges rather than state colleges.

related.note: ⚠ Where the next step lives: the associate degree in automotive service MANAGEMENT technology is filed under the engineering technologies series, and it is the usual route from the bay toward service management, warranty administration or teaching.
